title: finding(app-shell): a flow screen select with no placeholder shows a hard-coded English "Select…" under every locale, in the runtime FlowRunner dialog and the Studio preview (named producer: app-todo screen_1 category)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site, class (a). `reach:` a named producer, objectstack `examples/app-todo/src/flows/task.flow.ts` at `0f6dcac5e9`: `screen_1`'s `category` field (about `:440`), a `type: 'select'` with `options`, no `placeholder` and no `defaultValue`.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11219 (objectui#11190), from its contract review `5912983331` (③), which escalated it with class and reach. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The reading (objectui `origin/main` `e6bc087a3`, read, not rendered in a browser)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx:388`, in `ScreenFieldInput`: `SelectValue placeholder={field.placeholder || 'Select…'}`. The fallback is a hard-coded English literal.
- `ScreenView` takes no locale and offers no override for this string.
- It reaches every select-style screen field that declares no `placeholder`:
  - in the runtime `FlowRunner` dialog, under every non-en locale;
  - in Studio's flow screen preview, which renders through `ScreenView` since PR objectui#11219. Under a zh designer, "Select…" sits beside localized words.
- The same literal appears as a fallback in `packages/components/src/custom/config-field-renderer.tsx:138` (`field.placeholder ?? 'Select…'`). Whether that is a user-facing screen is for the claiming seat to measure. It is named here so that one fix covers both sites, or states why it doesn't.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- The fallback reads a localized string through the i18n path the screen already uses for its other chrome, or through the object form's existing placeholder string, if one exists. ⛔ No second hand-kept word list.
- Pins: under zh, a select screen field with no `placeholder` shows the localized fallback; an authored `placeholder` renders verbatim (the control).

## Dedupe

objectui issues and PRs were searched for `Select…` with `ScreenView`, `ScreenView placeholder`, and `screen field select placeholder i18n`: 0 hits. PR objectui#11219's own Acceptance notes name it, and they are the source.
